chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

chunks.arabic_text: فِي مُكَاتَبٍ بَيْنَ شَرِيكَيْنِ فَيُعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ الْخَادِمُ

translations.en: Regarding a mukatab jointly owned between two partners, and one of them frees his share, how is the servant to act?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ يَخْدُمُ الثَّانِيَ يَوْماً وَ يَخْدُمُ نَفْسَهُ يَوْماً

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He serves the second one one day, and he serves himself one day."

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ فَإِنْ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ مَالًا قَالَ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ بَيْنَ الَّذِي أَعْتَقَ وَ بَيْنَ الَّذِي أَمْسَكَ

translations.en: I said: "Then if he dies and leaves wealth?" He عليه السلام said: "The wealth is between them in two halves: between the one who freed and the one who retained."

en.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a mukatab jointly owned by two partners when one partner frees his share. The servant divides his service between the remaining partner and himself, and if he dies leaving wealth, that wealth is split equally between the partner who emancipated his share and the partner who retained his share.
en.seo_question: How is the labor and property of a jointly owned mukatab divided when one partner frees his share?

key_terms.مُكَاتَبٍ: a slave under a contract of emancipation
